summary: Stage scan (~5,000 pages) contains the same pages multiple times, with URLs containing '///' (repeated slashes) treated as distinct pages.
mechanism: Crawler did not normalize URLs with repeated slashes ('///'), so the same page was collected and scanned multiple times; a similar fix had previously been applied for the customer's prod property. Root cause details not in thread beyond CS-1622.
resolution: Engineering fix delivered under CS-1622; customer informed it was fixed.
ui_signals: duplicate pages in Page List with '///' in URL

summary: Logged-in UAT scan never included post-login pages (/basket, /my-account) despite login being configured; one later crawl returned 0 pages.
mechanism: Login page URL (/account/login) was not accessible to Evinced crawler IPs (not whitelisted on UAT env), so the login method could not find the username selector; magic-link access redirected to home page before login form. Also credentials were stale.
resolution: Got new credentials; support added an internal custom login script (multiple interactions) that first visits the magic link to gain env access and then navigates back to the login URL and logs in. Post-login pages then crawled.
log_signals: cannot find User Name Selector element
ui_signals: post-login pages missing from Page List

summary: Locale properties were picking up URLs of other locales; after customer added language include regex, crawls returned 0 pages.
mechanism: Customer-written include regex used a language code format that did not match the site's actual URL locale format, so the include filter excluded all pages (and before, no regex meant cross-locale pages were collected).
resolution: TAM corrected the include regex to match the landing-page URL format of the seed URLs; scans then succeeded.
ui_signals: pages from other locales in page list
gt_class_doubt: Post-change symptom was 0 pages (class 2); original symptom wrong-locale URLs fits class 4.

summary: Several US Magazines properties scanned far fewer pages / timed out compared to others; Veranda was unblocked earlier and customer asked for ETA for the rest.
mechanism: Suspected bot detection on some Hearst properties blocking/timeouting the crawler (some properties blocked, others not); not fully established in thread.
resolution: Temporary: engineering used an external scraper to bypass bot detection for Veranda; per-property assessment with Hearst IT tracked in CS-1820 and weekly check-ins.
log_signals: page load timeouts on blocked properties
ui_signals: difference in pages scanned between properties

summary: Crawl of hyatt.com found only 1 page even with default settings and IPs whitelisted; later page counts inconsistent.
mechanism: Customer whitelisted scanner IPs but crawler/scanner static-IP egress was not enabled for the tenant in Retool; additionally domain/regex config did not cover locale redirect (en-us -> en) and site returned HTTP 429 rate limiting causing retries and the scanner treating redirect target incorrectly.
resolution: Enabled static IPs for crawler and scanner in Retool; added regex + additional seed URLs/domains; added 'en' locale to config to handle en-us/en redirect. CS-2323.
log_signals: [browser] [error] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 429 ()
The request raced with another user request. Please try again.

summary: Marketing property page count fluctuated (1020 -> 850 -> 524 -> 206 -> 1099), then capped at 600; a Feb 1 scan failed.
mechanism: Crawler still had an old/incorrect password (login failed for crawler) and several pages spiked memory causing out-of-memory crashes during crawl; later count capped by max pages = 600. Feb 1 failure was a platform-wide incident (gotoURL timeout on login URL, kubernetes job failed).
resolution: Updated crawler password; moved property to internal config with increased resources; advised raising max page limit; RCA of Feb 1 failure in CS-2398.
log_signals: scan <scanId> has failed to run over kubernetes
encountered error while running a function with timeout. retry count: 0
Error. Function: gotoURL execution took more than 40000 miliseconds

summary: Customer asked to confirm Site Scanner origin IPs/user-agent because the scanner was being bounced by their bot defence.
mechanism: Customer's bot detection layer blocking Site Scanner despite IP whitelist.
resolution: Customer added new rules to their bot detection layer; scan succeeded.
gt_class_doubt: Mostly an IP/whitelist question; could be class 5 (access/config question).

summary: Authenticated crawl of nectar.com found no post-login pages (46 public pages), then 0 pages after adding seed URLs; later intermittent 403/'Access denied'.
mechanism: Requests from non-static IPs blocked by WAF/Akamai; login only worked from static IP. After IP whitelist on Phantom WAF, Akamai still rate-blocked scanner due to high request rate (403 Access denied). Login flow via multiple interactions also failed initially (x-argos-bypass-npac header injection issue).
resolution: Enabled static IPs for crawl/scan, configured multiple-interactions login on backend, customer whitelisted IPs and added Akamai bot exception; Evinced reduced concurrency as temporary workaround; full Akamai whitelist pending customer site relaunch.
log_signals: scanId ca782cf0-... failure in interaction flow
ui_signals: Multiple interactions are already set for this property. Contact support for assistance.

summary: Stores property page counts fluctuated wildly between crawls (486, 710, 413, 2746, 1875).
mechanism: Include regex ^https?://www.verizon.com/stores.* matched seed URLs, but these redirect to /nextgendigital/nos/storelocator/..., which did not match the regex and were skipped inconsistently.
resolution: Added the redirect-target path pattern to the include regex; crawl then found ~5K pages. CS-2432.
ui_signals: page count varies greatly between crawls

summary: DE-de property crawl returned 224 pages instead of usual ~730.
mechanism: Some crawler requests blocked by the site (page open timeouts); scanner IPs/static IP not configured for property.
resolution: Customer confirmed IPs whitelisted; support enabled static IP configs for urlset (crawl) and scan; next run back to 700+ pages. CS-2422.
log_signals: all attempts to scrape url had failed Exception: {"type":"OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT","additionalInfo":{}}

summary: View '[Blog] 360 Blog (IL)' showed 0 pages though the property scanned ~65K pages; IL blog pages previously ~450.
mechanism: The /il country root returned 404, so the crawler had no entry path to discover /il/blog pages (site structure change).
resolution: Added full /il/blog URL to seed list; next crawl included the IL blog pages. CS-2456.

summary: Bizmail crawl found only 1 page; portal.charter.odinapi.dev found 0 pages.
mechanism: Bizmail: menu navigation not implemented as standard <a href> links so crawler could not discover pages. Portal: login selectors #username/#password used ID syntax but fields only had name/data attributes, so login failed.
resolution: Added explicit module URLs to seed/list for Bizmail (CS-2498); advised customer to add id attributes or fix selectors for the portal (CS-2488).
gt_class_doubt: portal.charter.odinapi part is 0 pages (class 2) due to login selector.

summary: Onboarding: several expected app paths missing from crawl; authenticated pages redirected to /login mid-scan.
mechanism: Some paths only reachable via user flow/redirect or required session state/test data (expired test-user coverage); authenticated session was invalidated mid-crawl/scan because parallel concurrent browser sessions logged the user out (also ~60 min session timeout).
resolution: Added missing seed paths; split properties into authenticated/no-login; regex to sample article pages and exclude login-redirects; engineering added parallelism control and set it to 1. FR CS-2499 for mid-scan re-authentication.
ui_signals: pages redirected to login page in scan results

summary: Crawl found only one page; login form field selector IDs change on every reload.
mechanism: Login username/password element IDs are dynamic, and Site Scanner does not support dynamic selectors; additionally the post-login app has very few linked pages.
resolution: Support changed selectors to stable static ones and added the /change-password seed URL; crawl/scan worked.

summary: Crawl found only two pages because in-page navigation changes URL parameters/fragments rather than paths.
mechanism: Default Grouping Rules mapped URLs differing only in query parameters/fragments to the same page, collapsing distinct states into one.
resolution: Changed Grouping Rules to treat fragments and new URL parameters as new pages; crawl found 2K+ pages.
